panels.title: Observed active apartment rental listings
panels.description: Distinct article IDs in the fixed apartments + rent scope; active means last seen within 14 days and not closed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS observed_active_listings FROM dashboard_public.current_listings WHERE deal = 'rent' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[]

panels.title: Median asking rent · period as listed
panels.description: Median rental asking price. The collected evidence does not establish a monthly lease period, so no KM/month label is used.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS priced_sample, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price))::int AS median_asking_km FROM dashboard_public.current_listings WHERE deal = 'rent' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND price > 0

panels.title: New active rentals · 7 days
panels.description: First observed in the window, deduplicated by article ID; renewals are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT article_id)::int AS new_active_listings FROM dashboard_public.current_listings WHERE deal = 'rent' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'

panels.title: Rent asking summaries by rooms
panels.description: Rental prices by room label with sample sizes. Unknown room values are retained as unknown rather than discarded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(rooms, '(unknown)') AS rooms, count(*)::int AS priced_sample, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price))::int AS median_asking_km
FROM dashboard_public.current_listings
WHERE deal = 'rent' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND price > 0
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fresh rental listings
panels.description: The newest active rental observations in the fixed apartment scope.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT title, url, neighborhood, rooms, sqm, price, first_seen, renewed_at, last_seen
FROM dashboard_public.current_listings
WHERE deal = 'rent' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[]
ORDER BY first_seen DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent rental reductions
panels.description: Resolved valid-to-valid asking-price reductions; historical event time and current availability are separate fields.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT title, url, neighborhood, rooms, sqm, prior_price, new_price, reduction_km, reduction_pct, event_at, currently_observed
FROM dashboard_public.price_reductions
WHERE deal = 'rent' AND category_memberships @> ARRAY['apartments']::text[] AND event_at >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY event_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Freshness for apartment rentals
panels.description: A missing completed success is Unknown. This reflects the latest successful scrape, not a visitor refresh.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, configured_searches, last_success_at, CASE WHEN last_success_at IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN last_success_at < now() - INTERVAL '26 hours' THEN 'Stale' ELSE 'Current' END AS freshness
FROM dashboard_public.freshness WHERE category = 'apartments'
